task: Establish a universal theoretical framework for the rational design of multi-component nanoclusters and nanoparticles with specific symmetry and compositional sequences.
methods: Geometric construction using Archimedean lattices and hexagonal coordinates to predict magic numbers and shell sequences.
Calculation of optimal size mismatch between adjacent shells based on atomic radii.
Analysis of shell energies for stability prediction.
Dynamic growth simulation using Lennard-Jones potentials and path probability weights.
target_artifacts: Optimal size mismatch values between adjacent shells.
Shell sequences and paths formed via self-assembly in growth simulations.
